scope: One 350/700 MHz two-selector VC regulator with mainline cpufreq-dt and OPP; both CPUs online, no hotplug, U-Boot RAM boot, watchdog recovery, no display cycling
interpretation: Sequential sysfs and VC reads can straddle transitions. The first schedutil script required an impossible atomic snapshot and reported an assertion failure even though its shell test completed. A second sampler bracketed the hardware clock read with VC reads. No sampled interval showed actual 700 MHz with a stable low VC selector; mainline OPP code orders voltage before clock when scaling up and clock before voltage when scaling down.
limits: The small 12.66 mV nominal step does not qualify lower voltage or higher frequency settings.
Five minutes of two-core load passed at the tested 350 MHz point, but overnight stability and whole-device energy remain unmeasured.
The likely MPU INA channel is identified by stock software and load response, without PCB net tracing.
CPU hotplug remains disabled because its earlier OMAP4 PM path panicked.
The voltage provider relies on the inherited Cisco VC/VP register state; full PM/AVS integration, failure rollback, thermal cooling and persistent installation remain pending.
